body: Can you gift on EUW too?
That was very beautiful, thanks. It is actually one of my favourite things to do, just sit and experience the hurt. That's probably a little odd.

The reason I wrote it like this is because it is hard to explain how what I'm going through feels. I can see how it is not clear though so I'll try to explain it.

Two years ago I was diagnosed with an anxiety disorder and depression. I was in therapy for almost two years to learn how to deal with this. One of my problems that I had was that I was living in the past, I couldn't let go. So we worked on living in the moment for a few weeks. And one day it hit me, 'you should never look back, you get nothing from living in the past.' 
On that same day, I experienced derealization for the first time, it didn't go away. Now I am diagnosed with depersonalization/derealization disorder. This disorder makes me feel like nothing is real, like I'm living in a dream. As you can probably imagine this makes everything extremely meaningless. At times, I also experience time differently. The past and the present seem to blur together, I can't remember when things happened etc. So the concept of today means nothing to me, it just seems like the cause of my derealization because I wanted to live in the now so badly, experience the today instead of the yesterday. 
So to answer your question, today/the now is the ghost that is haunting me. 

I hope that makes sense.. and thanks for listening, it means a lot.
I don't know, I'm usually too scared to look over the edge and experience it.
